title: Ordinary Koszul tensor towers represent derived tensor towers
statement: Let S be a small site, O a sheaf of commutative rings, and D(O) its chosen unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For a finite sequence b of global sections, including the empty sequence, let Q be the strict dual Koszul tower [def-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-system]. For every cochain complex M there is an isomorphism of towers between the ordinary tensor tower M tensor Q followed by localization and Q followed by localization and the published derived tensor with Q(M) [lem-weil-pbc-site-derived-tensor-descent]. In particular the isomorphism intertwines every tower transition.

source.place: Tags 06YS and 06YU; Koszul tower comparison in the proof of Tag 0A0E

proof.text: Choose a flat-term K-flat resolution P to M. Convert categorical flatness of its terms to site flatness by the canonical tensor comparison.

The dual Koszul terms are K-flat and termwise flat. Tensoring P to M with each such term is a quasi-isomorphism by the fixed-tensor theorem. Naturality in the tower gives an isomorphism between the localized ordinary tensor towers.

Use the fixed-left-factor comparison for P, which is natural in every second complex and thus in the whole Koszul tower. Finally apply the derived tensor bifunctor to the isomorphism Q(P) to Q(M) in its first variable. Compose these three tower isomorphisms.

theorem koszulTensorDerivedTower (r : ℕ)
    (b : Fin r → (O.obj ⋙ forget CommRingCat).sections) (M : ringedSiteComplex O) :
    Nonempty (((ringedKoszulTensorTower O r b).obj M ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q) ≅
      (ringedKoszulDualTower O r b ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q ⋙
        (SheafOfModules.KFlatFixedTensor.derivedTensor O).obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj M)))
